title: Detection week, then switch the WAF to blocking
caption: docs/mvp/deployment-single-vm.md §6 (human step of X-039); deploy/caddy/waf/exclusions.conf.

steps.title: Start in detection
steps.body: `VELEXIS_WAF_ENGINE=DetectionOnly` in `/etc/velexis/caddy.env` before the first deploy with the WAF, or `sudo systemctl reload caddy` after setting it.
steps.expect: Requests that match rules still pass.

steps.title: Review daily
steps.body: `journalctl -u caddy -o cat | jq -r 'select(.logger == "http.handlers.waf") | .msg'` and the daily `security log review` summary (WAF matches by rule).
steps.expect: Each line names the rule id and the variable (`ARGS:json.travellers.0.lastName`), never a value.

steps.title: Exclude false positives
steps.body: Narrow rule in `exclusions.conf` (one rule, one argument, one path, with its reason) + the request in `caddy-smoke.sh`; PR and deploy.
steps.expect: The legitimate request no longer matches.

steps.title: Switch to blocking
steps.body: After a week without a new legitimate match remove the line from `caddy.env`; `sudo systemctl reload caddy`.
steps.expect: An attack-shaped request to `https://api.ota.example.com/v1/...` answers 403 `FORBIDDEN` with a request id.
